biceps-curl.start: Stand tall with palms forward, arms lowered, wrists neutral, and elbows close to the torso.
biceps-curl.finish: Curl both dumbbells toward the shoulders with palms up and the torso still.

dead-bug.start: Lie with head and shoulders relaxed on the floor, arms vertical, and hips and knees at 90 degrees.
dead-bug.finish: Extend the right arm and left leg while the opposite limbs remain in tabletop and the torso stays still.

dumbbell-floor-press.start: Lie on the floor with feet planted, upper arms resting lightly down, elbows at 90 degrees, and forearms vertical.
dumbbell-floor-press.finish: Press both dumbbells over the chest with straight arms, neutral wrists, and relaxed shoulders.

dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.start: Stand with dumbbells at the thighs, feet hip-width apart, shoulders controlled, and spine neutral.
dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.finish: Push the hips backward with a slight knee bend while keeping dumbbells close to the legs and the neck neutral.
avoid: moving dumbbells away from the legs

goblet-squat.start: Stand shoulder-width with toes slightly outward and one dumbbell held vertically at the chest in a secure goblet grip.
goblet-squat.finish: Squat to a comfortable depth with heels planted, knees tracking with toes, and chest upright.

incline-push-up.start: Place both hands on a stable waist-high bench and form a straight line from head through heels.
incline-push-up.finish: Lower the chest toward the bench with elbows 30 to 45 degrees from the torso while maintaining the body line.

one-arm-dumbbell-row.start: Use a staggered stance and one hand on a flat bench, with the working arm vertical and spine neutral.
one-arm-dumbbell-row.finish: Drive the working elbow toward the lower ribs or hip while keeping shoulders level and hips square.

standing-calf-raise.start: Stand on a flat floor with feet hip-width, heels planted, legs straight, and one hand lightly supported.
standing-calf-raise.finish: Raise both heels through the balls of the feet while keeping ankles aligned and torso vertical.

standing-hammer-curl.start: Stand tall with arms lowered, palms facing inward, wrists neutral, and elbows close to the torso.
standing-hammer-curl.finish: Curl both dumbbells while preserving the palms-in grip and keeping the torso still.
